research.title: Robustness of Text Classifiers to Lexical Distribution Shifts
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to compare text classifiers under vocabulary shifts, controlling training splits, preprocessing choices, and label distributions.
Evaluated lexical and contextual baselines, inspected prediction errors, and analyzed whether confidence calibration changed across original and perturbed evaluation sets.

work.title: Document Ingestion and Validation Utilities
bullets: Implemented assigned Python utilities for validating incoming document records, normalizing text fields, and reporting malformed inputs within an existing processing pipeline.
Added regression tests for parsing edge cases and investigated processing failures using application logs, documenting fixes for routine maintenance.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Extractive Summarization Methods
bullets: Implemented frequency based and graph based sentence ranking methods for extractive summarization, using shared tokenization and sentence segmentation procedures.
Compared summaries against reference texts using overlap metrics and manually inspected redundancy, sentence ordering, and coverage of central document content.

projects.title: Sequence Labeling for Named Entity Recognition
bullets: Implemented recurrent and token independent tagging baselines in PyTorch, holding input representations and training partitions constant for comparative evaluation.
Evaluated entity span precision and recall, then categorized boundary and label errors to examine differences between contextual and independent predictions.
